key.name: api-token
key.description: Authentication token for the Navitia API

key.name: departure-station-id
key.description: Navitia stop_area ID for the departure station

key.name: departure-station-name
key.description: Human-readable name of the departure station

key.name: arrival-station-id
key.description: Navitia stop_area ID for the arrival station (optional filter)

key.name: arrival-station-name
key.description: Human-readable name of the arrival station

key.name: panel-position
key.description: Position of the indicator in the top bar: left, center, or right

key.name: max-departures
key.description: Maximum number of departures to display

key.name: time-window
key.description: Show trains leaving within this many minutes

key.name: schedule-refresh-interval
key.description: Minutes between fetches of the planned timetable, used to detect cancelled trains

key.name: log-level
key.description: Logging verbosity: debug, info, warn, error, or off

key.name: coverage-region
key.description: Navitia coverage region ID (api.sncf.com uses a single "sncf" region)
